Research from the reading

Testing macro ideas

What was already in the price? Which policy tool moved? What evidence would change the interpretation? These studies take a claim from the reading and check it against dated observations.

What moved the yield curve before a speech?Compare observed 2s10s with the expected short-rate and term-premium components. Inspect the two tenors separately. What probability did dealers put on the decision?Follow the survey deadline, probabilities assigned to each rate range and eventual FOMC decision across 24 meetings. Does the announcement extend the earlier move?Across 230 FOMC statements, compare the four prior close-to-close changes with the two-year yield move in the statement window. Does emergency lending mean the Fed is easing?Follow discount-window lending, market funding costs and the policy rate through three US funding disruptions. Do cheaper oil prices lift industrial output?Compare US and euro-area energy prices, core inflation and industrial production following five large Brent declines. How long did Japan’s currency intervention last in the price?Trace the yen after official operations. Compare the moves with untreated dates and inspect the number of independent episodes.

What moved 2s10s before the Fed spoke?

Data, method and interpretation

The observed rates are US Treasury par yields. ACM fits zero-coupon yields. Its two additive components reconstruct the fitted yield, so a gap can remain between the observed and fitted moves. For 2s10s, subtract each two-year change from its corresponding ten-year change. For a single tenor, read the changes in that yield directly.

Use the last jointly observed two- and ten-year Treasury closes strictly before the event. The five-quote option spans four close-to-close intervals. Both endpoints must have ACM estimates. Same-day speeches count once. The non-overlapping option works forward in time within the chosen sample, keeping the next window whose first quote follows the last retained endpoint.

Correlations are Pearson correlations across the displayed dates. Direction counts exclude zero moves in either series. The ACM expected-rate component averages short rates over the selected bond’s life. Estimating the odds of the next FOMC decision requires a meeting-linked instrument or an explicitly identified survey. ACM fits Treasury yields, so the model and the observed slope share underlying market information. A high correlation can partly reflect that construction. The workbook contains revised model estimates, and overlapping windows share observations. The comparisons describe historical co-movement and leave the causal shock unidentified.

Proposed research

Questions still to test

Did short-term foreign debt make currencies more exposed to a common shock?

Before the September 2008, March 2020 and March 2022 market stresses, rank emerging economies by short-term external debt relative to reserves. Use the calendar year ending two years before each stress year to allow for reporting delays. Compare the percentage change in the BIS broad nominal effective exchange rate from the preceding month to the third month of each episode.

What would weaken the interpretation? If the ranking disappears when one economy or one episode is omitted, the ratio has little claim to general predictive value. A peg can absorb pressure through reserve losses while its exchange rate barely moves.

Predicted result, data and limitations

Economies facing larger near-term refinancing needs should show larger currency declines within the same episode. Use only matched country observations. The World Bank measure uses original maturity, includes overdue interest and counts gold in reserves. It does not reveal usable reserves or banks’ hedges. Today’s revised series supports a historical comparison; a real-time forecasting claim would require vintages.

How long do dealers carry a large Treasury auction award?

For nominal ten-year Treasury note auctions, compare the dealer-awarded share of competitive bids accepted with weekly changes in dealers’ net Treasury coupon positions in the seven-to-eleven-year maturity bucket. Align the last report before the auction, the first report on or after settlement, and the following three reports. Compare large and small award shares within the same reporting regime.

What would weaken the interpretation? If dealer positions are already higher before large awards, or do not subsequently differ from small-award weeks, the data offer little support for temporary post-auction inventory accumulation.

Predicted result, data and limitations

A larger dealer award should leave more inventory on dealers’ books at settlement, with part of that increase reversing as customers absorb the bonds. Dealers can hedge or trade before issue. The weekly position covers several bonds and dealer firms, while the auction figure is a flow for one security. Keep new issues and reopenings separate, and compare only like maturity buckets across New York Fed reporting breaks.
